messages:
Mia Tran: Quick async — Aurora private deploy preflight. Need a thumbs-up on network, image packaging, and security artifacts by EOD so we can start the cutover window tomorrow.
Samir Patel: Network side: spoke with their infra lead, they’ll open the following to our egress NAT: 10.64.0.0/22 -> allow outbound 443 and 8443. Waiting for ACL ticket from their side. ETA today 3pm PT.
Priya Nair: Security checklist: need signed NDA addendum (they sent via DocuSign), and KMS integration plan. I have a short doc with required IAM roles — ping me if you want the minimal set.
Jin Park: CR for the onprem-config PR is up: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/482. I requested review from eng-runtime and eng-infra — can one of you take a look? small change: switch to static KV mount for airgap.
Taylor Ortiz: Taking runtime review now. Quick Q: does the onprem image include our fallback model packs or do we stream from private registry?
Anika Bose: We bundle the minimal quantized model + offline tokenizer in the airgapped tarball. Registry only used for future updates (we'll provide patch tooling).
Samir Patel: Ops note: for the VPC peering step they requested route propagation disabled — that blocks dynamic route injection. We suggested BGP static routes instead. Their network team is evaluating.
Priya Nair: On KMS: they want to use their HSM via PKCS#11. We support it but need the connector secrets in the airgap bundle. Anika can you include the connector template and obfuscation instructions?
Anika Bose: Yep — I'll add template and a short runbook. Will also include checksums for all artifacts. Example manifest entry:
```
- artifact: aurora-airgap-2026-03.tar.gz
  sha256: e3b0c44298fc...
  contents:
    - runtime.tar
    - model.quant
    - tokenizer.tar
    - kms-connector.tpl
```
Mia Tran: Perfect. Jin, any blocker on packaging script? We need a reproducible build that their ops can validate offline.
Jin Park: Packaging script updated in CI to output signed manifest. Still need to wire the signing key rotation docs. If Priya ok with the key handling language, I can merge.
Priya Nair: I'll review the key rotation doc by 1pm. If all good, signoff from security.
Samir Patel: ACL ticket just created on their side: NET-2345. They included proposed static routes. I put a note about port 8443 for health checks.
Taylor Ortiz: I did a quick smoke locally with the airgap artifact — health-check endpoint expects /healthz and returns 200 within 2s. Make sure their LB has the same probe path.
Mia Tran: Noted. Who owns the LB health probe verification on customer side? @Samir can you confirm with their infra lead and loop back here?
Samir Patel: Will confirm and update by 3:30pm PT. If they change probe path we'll update runbook.
Ops Bot: Deploy ticket created: DPL-7890. Associated tasks: network validation, artifact handoff, KMS connector test, canary deploy in staging. Reminder: add rollout window to ticket.
Anika Bose: Also flagging packaging QA: I need an eng-infra pair to run the offline install once we hand off tarball. Volunteers?
Taylor Ortiz: I can do the install test at 5pm PT with Jin.
Mia Tran: Awesome. Summary: Priya to finish security signoff by 1pm, Samir to confirm LB probe and ACLs by 3:30pm, Jin/Taylor run offline install at 5pm, Anika finalize bundle + runbook. If all green we proceed with cutover tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Ack, will update thread with NET-2345 link when I get reply.
Priya Nair: Shared a quick note on required audit logging — they need at least 90 days retention. I'll attach the spec to DPL-7890 after review.
Jin Park: Merging PR after Priya signoff. Will tag image aurora-onprem:v1.2.0-signed.
Mia Tran: Thanks everyone. If anything slips, ping here; otherwise I’ll close the preflight checklist at 6pm.
